title: Regenerate and push Geas skills on pull requests
description: Extend PR CI to deterministically regenerate the packaged generic Geas skill and the exported open-source-research-agents ontology skill, verify their complete snapshots, and write changed generated bytes back to the PR head without granting untrusted repository content elevated credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Same-repository PRs regenerate both skills with the checked-out Geas code, prove deterministic repeat output, commit only exact managed generated paths when bytes changed, avoid workflow loops, and expose a safe explicit behavior for fork PRs where GitHub does not grant write authority. Tests cover changed/unchanged output, push failure, fork handling, path confinement, and no secret exposure.
notes:
User selected the Epiphytic Octo STS GitHub App at sts.epiphytic.org. Add an org policy in Epiphytic/.github under .github/chainguard/geas-pr-skill-sync.sts.yaml, modeled on octo-sts-production but restricted to repositories: [geas] and permissions: {contents: write}. Recommended security design: unprivileged pull_request workflow generates/verifies both exact .agents/skills snapshots and uploads a confined artifact; a separate trusted workflow_run workflow from refs/heads/main downloads but never executes it, verifies PR/head metadata and exact paths/hashes, exchanges OIDC through octo-sts/action pinned to a full commit, and pushes only to an Epiphytic/geas PR head whose SHA still matches. Trust policy should use exact subject repo:Epiphytic/geas:ref:refs/heads/main plus exact custom claims for repository_id, event_name=workflow_run, and workflow_ref for the protected write-back workflow. External forks remain verification/artifact-only unless the App is separately installed on the fork.
Epiphytic/geas immutable GitHub repository_id is 1320458746; bind this exact claim in the Octo STS policy in addition to repository name.
Design approved by user: two-workflow privilege split, exact Octo STS org policy, contents:write only for geas, immutable repository/workflow/event claims, full action SHA pin, same-repository head-SHA-constrained push, fork verification/artifact-only.
close_reason: Deterministic unprivileged generation and protected Octo STS write-back implemented; both repos independently reviewed clean
